articles.description: Orlando City SC has fired interim head coach Martín Perelman and interim assistant coach Sebastián Setti after losing to FC Cincinnati in an MLS Cup Eastern Conference wild-card match.

articles.headline: Son Heung-Min: Thomas Müller spot-on about lack of pressure in MLS
